summary: This chunk adds three new grading/timing files for the 'oncall-rotation-plan-redteam' eval's without_skill run-1. grading.json scores an adversarial review against 9 expectations (6 passed, 1 failed=3, 0.67 pass rate), covering timezone-gap detection, Krakow readiness risks, IC-pool contradiction, and goal-failure verdict, but faulting missing strict rank ordering, missing per-finding retest checks, and an unprioritized fix list. It also includes claim verification, user notes on workarounds (Write tool refusal, session resume), and eval-feedback suggestions for refining the expectation set. Two identical timing.json files record 38052 tokens and 28.7s duration, noting the run was killed by a session limit and resumed.

claims.text: 9 expectations evaluated with 6 passed, 3 failed, pass_rate 0.67
Krakow 08:00-20:00 CET converts to 02:00-14:00 ET, leaving 20:00-02:00 ET uncovered
The IC pool is entirely US-based and a Sev1 at 10:00 CET (04:00 ET) pages a sleeping US engineer, undermining the zero-overnight-pages metric
No per-finding retest checks exist; only a few findings embed fix gates (C2 live-fire drill, H3 game-day scenarios)
The closing gate list is a minimum-changes list but carries no priority order
Industry floor for a sustainable rotation is 4-6 people
Write tool refused to create report.md due to a harness guard, so the executor wrote it via Bash heredoc instead
Executor run was killed by a session limit and resumed

risks.note: Two timing.json files at different path depths contain byte-identical content (same tokens, duration, note).
